title: Rehearse the agentified day
learning_outcome: Walk the bounded job through a day, including a block and a human decision.
exercise: Rehearse six beats and record what stops when a receipt or approval is missing.

scenes.narration_exact: “The Six-Beat Day begins with a brief. What was prepared? What needs a human? What may be worth learning? Harbor's answer is short: one paper brief was drafted; staffing and spend need decisions; a layout question may deserve a test. The brief must carry receipts and uncertainty. If it reads like an endless task list, the system has handed burden back to Morgan.”

scenes.narration_exact: “Third, review. Morgan reads the brief beside its source-status summary and trace template. One course source is stale for the proposed month. The agent's draft sounds confident anyway. Morgan marks the claim unsupported and keeps the staffing hold in place. Fourth, approve. There is nothing to approve for a team proposal today. Morgan may approve a correction to the paper draft for later review, but that is not approval to book a session, spend money, or send an announcement.”

scenes.narration_exact: “Fifth, recover. Suppose the paper handoff is incomplete: the draft lacks its source-status field. Morgan does not fill the gap by guessing. The recovery choice is to return the brief for a corrected paper draft, preserve the earlier version, and record why. There is no automatic retry or provider call. Sixth, learn. The repeated missing source-status field could become a memory proposal: require that field in future briefs. It stays a proposal until Morgan reviews its source, scope, and expiry. One bad draft does not write policy by itself.”
scenes.on_screen_copy_exact: “5. Recover: preserve, correct, trace.” “6. Learn: proposal, then review.”

scenes.narration_exact: “Write a Six-Beat Day brief for your workflow. For each beat, name the item, evidence, owner, safe action, and stop condition. Make one thing fail. Show how the operator recovers without hiding the original version. Mark any lesson as a memory proposal rather than an approved rule. Close with the question you would ask after a busy day. Use a fictional or approved example. Do not use private operational data, open a live account, import a trace, or contact a person.”
scenes.on_screen_copy_exact: Exercise card below; 3:20 quiet writing timer with optional pause.
scenes.exercise_prompt_exact: Produce a `Six-Beat Day` brief with brief, route, review, approve, recover, and learn. Each beat needs an item, evidence reference, owner, permissible next step, and stop condition. Include one failure and its version-preserving recovery path. End by answering, “What did I approve today that I should have questioned?” Use only invented activity; the preparation agent cannot grant its own authority.
